top_signals.title: The Double Alignment Problem: Civil-Military Relations in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
top_signals.summary:
Artificial intelligence poses the greatest challenge to American civil-military relations since the advent of the nuclear bomb. AI plays outside the political bounds that contain other challenges, however odious. It compounds the inherent problem of civil-military relations – aligning the state and the military – with an additional alignment problem: that of human and agent. In doing so, AI threatens to undermine the constitutionalism and professionalism on which status quo civil-military relations depend. top_signals.title: European Natural Gas Prices Surge 8.6% as Cold Snap Looms
top_signals.summary: Natural gas prices in Europe started the week with a rise to 96.075 euros per MWh, gaining 8.6% from Friday as weather forecasts saw colder weather coming to the continent, which is struggling with record-low inventories. The benchmark TTF price is equal to $105.49 per MWh and is the highest daily price rise in over a week, Bloomberg reported today. Even though the TTF price has dropped from the four-year high of over 100 euros per MWh reached in late October, Europe’s benchmark gas price has now nearly tripled from $33 (30 euros) per MWh…
